transcript.text: Hi, we've just had a Bosch KGN36VLEAG delivered last week and it makes a gurgling, bubbling sound like water running, plus a click every so often and a crack noise at night. Is it faulty? It's driving my husband mad.

[Heading: Probably normal]
This sounds completely normal for a new fridge-freezer. The gurgling and bubbling is the refrigerant circulating through the cooling pipes, which often sounds exactly like water running. The clicking is likely the thermostat switching the compressor on or off, and the cracking noises at night are caused by the plastic interior panels expanding and contracting as the temperature changes during the defrost cycle. Since it was delivered last week, these noises are very common while the appliance settles in. It is only a fault if you notice the fridge getting warm to the touch or if there is an oily residue anywhere on the outside (which would indicate a leak). If the food stays cold and there's no warmth or oil, your husband can rest easy—it's just doing its job.

candidates.cause: Normal refrigerant flow and plastic expansion
